dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Key numbers for customers, stamps and rewards.

staff.title: Welcome!
staff.description: Open the staff console to confirm stamps and check gift cards.

kpi.retentionDetail: {{returned}} of {{cohort}} new customers came back within 30 days

heatmap.title: Busiest hours
heatmap.description: Stamps by day of week and hour (company local time).

profile.title: Profile
profile.languageHint: Your choice applies on all your devices and in emails.

password.title: Change password
password.changed: Password changed. Sessions on other devices have been signed out.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.regenerateHint: Your old recovery codes will stop working.
security.pausedHint: Two-step verification is temporarily off: no code is asked at sign-in. The entry in your authenticator app is kept — its code is enough to turn it back on.

done.remove: Two-step verification was removed. You can set it up again at any time.

pause.title: Turn off two-step verification
pause.description: No code will be asked at sign-in. The entry in your app is kept, so you can turn it back on later with a code from the same app. Enter your current password to confirm.

resume.title: Turn two-step verification back on
resume.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

remove.title: Remove two-step verification
remove.description: The secret and all recovery codes will be deleted. To use it again you will scan a new QR code (for example, after changing phones). Enter your current password to confirm.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices signed in to your account. Sign out any session you don't recognise and change your password.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Invite staff and manage their roles and access.

invite.title: New staff invitation
invite.description: An invitation email with a link valid for 72 hours will be sent.

confirm.disable: Block {{name}}? All of their sessions will be signed out immediately.
confirm.resetMfa: Reset two-step verification for {{name}}? Their sessions will be signed out; no code will be asked at the next sign-in and they can set it up again.
confirm.delete: Delete {{name}}? Their account will be closed immediately and removed from the team list. The history of past actions is kept.

platform.title: Companies
platform.subtitle: Companies on the platform. Each company has its own database and its own domain.

provision.title: New company
provision.description: A separate database and access roles will be created for the company. This may take a few seconds.
provision.slugHint: Lowercase Latin letters, digits and underscores; used in the database name and cannot be changed later.
provision.domainHint: E.g. moyka.mockcoffe.com. The DNS record must point to this server.

detail.suspendConfirm: The company's domain will stop serving requests immediately. Continue?
detail.resetMfaConfirm: Reset two-step verification for {{name}}? Do this only when the owner has lost both the phone and the recovery codes. The action is recorded in the audit log.
detail.unavailable: The company is not active — its data is unavailable.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: The company’s addresses (e.g. moyka.mockcoffe.com). Customer and admin apps are resolved by domain.
domains.confirmPrimary: Make {{host}} the primary domain? Invitation links and new tags will use it. The old domain keeps working.
domains.confirmRemove: Remove {{host}}? Tags programmed with this address will stop working.

tags.title: NFC tags
tags.description: Only you can add tags. The first {{limit}} tag(s) per company are free, the rest are paid.
tags.noBranches: The company has no active branch. The owner must create a branch before tags can be added.

audit.title: Platform audit log
audit.subtitle: Company creation and suspension, domains and owners’ 2FA.

sms.title: SMS report
sms.subtitle: SMS messages used by companies in the selected period.
sms.invalidRange: The start date cannot be after the end date.
sms.empty: No SMS were sent in this period.
sms.note: Only successfully sent SMS are counted. Days are counted in Baku time.

failures.title: SMS that could not be sent
failures.empty: No failed SMS in this period.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Company SMS campaigns. Approve after payment — sending starts automatically between 09:00 and 21:00.
campaigns.approveConfirm: Has the payment been received? {{total}} SMS will be sent after approval.

staffConsole.title: Staff console
staffConsole.subtitle: Gift card redemptions and stamps awaiting approval at your location.

pending.title: Stamps awaiting approval
pending.rejectHint: E.g. the customer did not order. The reason is written to the audit log.

simulator.title: NFC simulator
simulator.subtitle: Development only: simulates tapping a tag. Every press increments the counter and creates a new signed link — just like a real tag.
simulator.replayHint: Opening the same link twice must show "Link already used" (replay protection).
simulator.qr: Scan with a phone (if the domain resolves on the phone).

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Loyalty programme rules. Changes take effect immediately and are written to the audit log.

stamps.title: Stamp rules
stamps.description: Prevents abuse. The time limit counts from the customer’s last stamp at any location.
stamps.intervalHint: 0 — no limit. E.g. 20: after a stamp at one location, the customer cannot get another at any location for 20 minutes.
stamps.maxPerDayHint: The day follows the company’s time zone.
stamps.approvalHint: The stamp is not added to the card until a staff member approves it in the staff console.
stamps.timeoutHint: Stamps not approved within this time are rejected automatically.

reward.title: Reward
reward.description: Which reward is given at which stamp. E.g. 5 stamps → free wash, 9 stamps → free coffee.
reward.stampsHint: From 1 to 50. A gift card is created when the last stamp is added.
reward.name: Reward name
reward.translationHint: If a translation is missing, the Azerbaijani name is shown.
reward.issued_one: {{count}} customer with a full card received a gift card.
reward.issued_other: {{count}} customers with a full card received a gift card.

change.title: Stamps required change: {{from}} → {{to}}
change.inProgress_one: {{count}} customer has a card in progress. What should happen to it?
change.inProgress_other: {{count}} customers have cards in progress. What should happen to them?
change.keep_one: Cards in progress finish on the old rule ({{count}} stamp)
change.keep_other: Cards in progress finish on the old rule ({{count}} stamps)
change.keepHint: Recommended. Nobody loses stamps or gets an automatic reward. The new rule starts with the next card after a reward and for new customers.
change.applyNow: Apply the new rule to everyone now
change.applyNowHint_one: {{count}} gift card will be issued immediately to customers who already reach the new threshold.
change.applyNowHint_other: {{count}} gift cards will be issued immediately to customers who already reach the new threshold.
change.applyNowNone: No gift cards will be issued immediately; all cards will count towards the new threshold.

company.title: Company
company.description: Name and description customers see (in 3 languages), brand colour and time zone.
company.name: Company name
company.brandColorHint: Main colour of the customer app and stamp icons.
company.smsSenderHint: Required. This name appears in the code message sent to customers. Latin letters and digits, up to 11 characters. The sender name is TrendStamp for all companies.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the customer app, next to the company name. If none is uploaded, a default icon is shown.
logo.requirements: Requirements: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB, shorter side at least 192 pixels. A square image (e.g. 512×512) is recommended — other images are cropped to a square from the centre.
logo.removed: Logo removed; the default icon is shown.
logo.invalid: The file does not meet the requirements: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB, shorter side at least 192 pixels.

company.smsPreview: The SMS will be sent like this:

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: Name and address in 3 languages, opening hours and a separate stamp rule per branch.
branches.dialogDescription: Name and address are shown to customers in their language.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.closeHint: A closed branch stays in lists but cannot be picked for new work. The last active branch cannot be closed.
branches.policyDescription: The time between stamps is still counted from the customer’s last stamp at any branch.
branches.useOwnPolicyHint: When off, the company’s default rule applies.
branches.enforceHours: Give stamps only during opening hours
branches.enforceHoursHint: Taps do not give a stamp while the branch is closed.
branches.companyPolicyUsed: This branch uses the company’s default stamp rule.

giftDesk.title: Gift card
giftDesk.subtitle: Type the customer’s code or scan the QR.
giftDesk.scanTitle: Point the camera at the QR code
giftDesk.scanHint: The card is checked automatically once the code is recognised.
giftDesk.cameraError: Could not open the camera. Allow access or type the code.
giftDesk.recentEmpty: No cards have been used at this branch yet.
giftDesk.recentNote: Note: the 5 most recently used gift cards at this branch are shown.

customers.title: Customers
customers.subtitle: Search, filters, each customer’s stamp history and manual adjustments.

detail.blockConfirm: Block {{name}}? They will be signed out immediately and cannot collect new stamps.

adjust.title: Manual stamp adjustment
adjust.description: For example, add a stamp when the tag did not work, or remove one given by mistake. Every adjustment is recorded in the audit log.
adjust.removeHint: The latest stamps are revoked. If you remove more than are on the card, the latest unused gift card is revoked too.
adjust.invalid: Check the count (1–50), the reason (at least 5 characters) and the branch.

tags.title: NFC tags
tags.subtitle: Counter tags, their status and tap log.
tags.managedByPlatform: Tags are installed and managed by the platform. Contact the platform if you need a new tag or a tag is not working.
tags.pendingKey: New key v{{version}} — package not downloaded
tags.pendingExported: New key v{{version}} — waiting for the first tap

confirm.disable: Disable "{{label}}"? All taps on this tag will be rejected immediately.
confirm.rotate: Create new keys for "{{label}}"? The old key keeps working until the tag is reprogrammed with the new keys.

register.title: New NFC tag
register.description: The server creates 3 random keys. Then download the provisioning package and program the tag; the first tap activates it.
register.label: Label
register.invalid: Check the UID (14 hex characters), the label and the branch.

package.title: Provisioning package: {{uid}} (v{{version}})
package.description: Download the JSON file and program the tag with an NFC reader: java tools/nfc/ProgramTag.java package.json (see docs/nfc-ntag424-programming.md).
package.once: The keys are shown only now and will never be shown again. Keep the file safe and delete it after programming.

events.title: "{{label}}" — tap log
events.description: Last 100 attempts: accepted and rejected, with reasons.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Who did what and when. The log cannot be changed or deleted.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Send SMS campaigns to your customers. A campaign is sent after platform approval.

new.title: New campaign
new.description: Write the text and pick the audience — the number of SMS is calculated right away.
new.textHint: Your company SMS name is added to the beginning automatically.
new.sent: The campaign was sent for platform approval. It will be approved and sent after payment.
new.personalizedHint: Each SMS starts with "Hörmətli <customer name>,"; customers without a name get "Hörmətli istifadəçi,".

preview.title: Preview
preview.latinAdvice: In Latin letters, {{segments}} SMS per customer, {{total}} SMS in total will be sent:
preview.latinOn: The SMS will be sent in Latin letters (including the greeting, the customer name and the text). One SMS holds 160 characters.
preview.nonLatin: The text contains non-Latin characters — one SMS holds 70 characters instead of 160.

list.title: My campaigns
list.pendingNote: It will be approved by the platform after payment. Sending happens between 09:00 and 21:00.
list.cancelConfirm: Delete this campaign? It will stay in the history as "Cancelled".

audience.INACTIVE: Customers who have not visited for a while
